ENERZONE
Smarter Decisions. For a Healthier Earth.
About Our Team
ENERZONE is a multidisciplinary team passionate about technology, science, innovation, and environmental sustainability.
For the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we are developing Field Shift, a web-based platform that helps farmers explore smarter crop rotation strategies using NASA Earth observation data, soil information, and local agricultural conditions. We are looking for "web builders" and App developer
